source: Kimi K2.7 Code PP13 qualification telemetry on 2026-06-13 plus first-three PP8 Qwen/Gemma measured per-layer memory from profiles/production/first3_resident_memory_budget.json.

resident_batch_token_budget.notes: Kimi2.7 moves to batch 32 with a 65536-token service gate after the first DSAPI 92-question run showed 56/69 completed rows, near-1% live KV use at batch 16, and long-tail stalls. Qwen uses its live max_num_seqs=32 service cap and Gemma stays at batch 16 until a separate relaunch gate.

kimi_batch32_fit_estimate.basis: Live Kimi2.7 PP13 DSAPI run used an 8 GiB fixed GPU KV cap, max_num_seqs=16, and max_num_batched_tokens=32768; vLLM reported roughly 1% KV usage while the run stalled on long active decodes. The next qualification doubles max_num_seqs and the token gate without increasing fixed KV.
kimi_batch32_fit_estimate.notes: This is an order-of-magnitude fit check, not a substitute for a relaunch. It says max_num_seqs=32 should still fit comfortably with the fixed 8 GiB Kimi KV cap; the practical constraints are scheduler workspace, answer length, and quality.

projection.notes: Projection subtracts Qwen and Gemma model-layer estimates plus 2 GiB/node local CPU LMCache allowance from live Kimi-only MemAvailable. It does not count GPU-power margin; enforce power first through batch limits and service concurrency until a hardware power cap is proven.

power_policy.hardware_power_limit_status: No reliable per-Spark 150W NVML/powercap limit was exposed by nvidia-smi or /sys/class/powercap during the 2026-06-11 probe.
power_policy.initial_control: Use DSAPI service batch limits, token budgets, and one-running-batch-per-compute-domain admission until a hardware power cap is proven. Qwen batch 32 is coordinator-safe because the live service is already launched with --max-num-seqs 32; Kimi moves to batch 32 through a deliberate model-service relaunch, while Gemma stays at batch 16 until a separate relaunch gate.

promotion_gates: Kimi2.7 COMPSEC17 and 92-question runs stay within the accepted quality range for the smart lane.
Kimi2.7, Qwen27 PP13, and Gemma4 PP13 services are all launched from pulled main checkouts and pass DSAPI smoke through the triad topology.
LMCache canaries prove cache load/store does not change answers for each resident service.
Batch 32/32/16 throughput test keeps all active GPUs busy without resource-governor throttling.
